title: I Could’ve Sat Here All Day — Qixingtan Beach Is That Peaceful | Trip.com Hualien
description:
Peaceful Qixingtan Beach

A serene expanse of smooth pebbles lines the shore of Qixingtan Beach in Hualien, Taiwan, where gentle waves roll in under a blanket of gray clouds. The muted tones of the sea blend with the overcast sky, evoking a sense of calm and solitude. A cool breeze drifts across the scene, enhancing the refreshing coastal ambiance.

This weekday visit reveals the beach’s reputation as a hidden gem for travelers seeking tranquility. The unique pebble shoreline and soft, rhythmic surf make Qixingtan Beach a peaceful retreat away from crowded tourist spots.

supplementary.description:
Tranquil Pebble Beach Stone Stack

A carefully balanced stack of smooth, pale stones sits atop a bed of rounded pebbles, framed by the vibrant turquoise waters of Qixingtan Beach in Hualien, Taiwan. The stones, worn by the ocean’s ebb and flow, contrast with the deep blue sea and the soft white clouds scattered across the sky. This minimalist arrangement highlights the natural textures and colors of the coastal landscape.

Visitors to Qixingtan Beach often stroll along the pebble shore, enjoying the rhythmic sound of waves and the gentle sea breeze. The site is renowned for its fault-formed curved bay and offers free access year-round, with peak season from April to October. Popular pastimes include watching sunrises and sunsets, stacking stones for good luck, cycling along the coastal path, and sampling local snacks from nearby vendors.
